about.text: Sweden’s soured cream: cream of usually 12 % fat, homogenised, pasteurised and then soured with a culture. It was first tried in Sweden as “sur grädde”, a word-for-word translation of the English sour cream.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Cream of about 12 % fat is homogenised and pasteurised, then soured with a culture. Temperatures, times and species are not given by the source; the general mesophilic cultured-cream method is under Cultured cream grades.
